criteria.requirement: The independent native list/tuple/iterator/generator, order, callback, repeated-ID, storage and enumeration-failure matrix and the fixed complete upstream regression must pass. Rule enumeration must finish before any rule is applied; this adds no general rollback guarantee for arbitrary callback exceptions.

Deliver meaningful public regressions that fail for the original one-shot bug, verify all documents and returned IDs, and cover enumeration failure without partial changes. Inspect actual candidate assertions and implementation; a prose claim or weakened tests is incomplete.
Only update_multiple and authorized public regressions may change; preserve existing order, repeated IDs and storage APIs without private-check, dependency or broad transaction changes.

comparison: Evaluate factual grounding, actual business behavior and constraints. Accept concise or equivalent valid answers; do not grade keyword matching, answer length, or similarity to a reference answer.
